description: This PHP script handles an AJAX request to retrieve and process MTA log data from a system command, then outputs the log in JSON format. It includes access control, executes a system command to get logs, processes the log file, and returns structured data.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a system command to fetch logs

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if the log file exists

methods.name: file
methods.description: Reads the log file into an array of lines

methods.name: htmlentities
methods.description: Converts characters to HTML entities for safe display

methods.name: json_encode
methods.description: Encodes the log data into JSON format
